constructors.reference: Tambara--Yamagami, Journal of Algebra 209 (1998), Theorem 1; EGNO, Tensor Categories, crossed products; explicit tensor constructor in evidence/anyonwiki/verify.py
constructors.source_construction: Tambara--Yamagami category on C3 crossed with the strict order-two action a -> -a, m -> m. The standard bicharacter chi(a,b)=exp(2pi i ab/3) and positive tau=1/sqrt(3) are invariant; its action is unitary.

constructors.source_construction: The rank-eight fusion subcategory of the standard unitary SO(12) level-two category, with dimensions 1,1,1,1,2,2,sqrt(6),sqrt(6).

constructors.source_construction: The standard unitary odd metaplectic SO(9) level-two modular category.

constructors.source_construction: The Drinfeld center of the unitary pointed category Vec(S3), equivalently Rep(D(S3)), with trivial cocycle.

constructors.reference: Cui--Galindo--Plavnik--Wang, On Gauging Symmetry of Modular Categories, CMP 348 (2016), S3 gauging example; AnyonWiki FR_8_1_0_29
constructors.source_construction: Gauge the full S3 symmetry of the unitary three-fermion category SO(8)_1 and take the neutral component of its universal Z2 grading: rank eight, FPdim 72.
